Subject: Offer proposal: Samir Nair (Senior Software Engineer, IC4)

Hi Laura / Markus,

Following up after yesterday's debrief with the hiring panel — Samir (external) is our preferred candidate for the Senior SWE (IC4) role on the Serving Runtime team. Below is the recommended standard offer we put together based on comp bands and market data. Requesting approval to extend.

Proposed package (standard offer template):
- Base salary: $190,000 per year (within L4 band $170,000–$210,000)
- Target bonus: 12% (annual, based on company performance)
- Equity: 0.50% RSU grant, 4-year vesting (25/25/25/25) with 1-year cliff
- Signing bonus: $10,000 (one-time) — included to match counter offers
- Start date: target May 4, 2026 (flexible)

Attachments: Offer_Letter_SamirNair_v1.pdf (draft), Comp_Bands_Q1_2026.xlsx (reference).

Notes / asks:
1) This sits in the middle of the L4 band; we used 0.50% equity to align with other IC4 hires on the Serving team.
2) If you want to push base higher, we can move to $195k but that will require sign-off from finance for budget delta.
3) Please confirm approval or suggest adjustments by EOD so recruiting can extend the offer tomorrow.

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Senior Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference

Monica — thanks for the writeup. A few quick clarifications before I approve: 

- Is the 0.50% RSU consistent with what we just granted to the other IC4s in Q1? I want a quick parity check with the Serving team hires (Gabrielle / Mateo).
- Can you confirm the budget owner sign-off path if we decide to increase base to $195k? I'll loop finance but want to know the lead time.
- Do we have any visa/relocation requirements flagged for Samir? He mentioned potential need for relocation assistance in the interview.

If the comp band spreadsheet shows parity and Vivek confirms finance OK for up to $195k without escalation, approve to extend at $190k + $10k signing bonus and the 0.50% equity. If finance approves $195k quickly, we can offer that instead.

Please reply with a one-line confirmation so I can close the loop and ask recruiting to send the offer.

Best,

Laura / Monica — I reviewed the comp bands and the notes from the interview panel. Quick decisions: 

- Approve the offer. Base at $195,000 is acceptable given the candidate's experience and the market for attention-optimized inference engineers.
- Increase equity to 0.60% RSU to keep alignment with the last two IC4 hires on the Serving team.
- Signing bonus $10k remains approved.

Vivek — can you confirm finance availability for the ~$5k base delta relative to the original recommendation (annualized delta ~$5k) and confirm this doesn't require adverse variance reporting? If you can green-light, Monica please proceed to extend at $195k / 12% target bonus / 0.60% RSU / $10k signing.
